sections.name: Getting comfortable
sections.hint: Gently accelerate, then try the brakes. There is no time limit.

sections.name: A gentle bend
sections.hint: Keep left and make small steering adjustments.

sections.name: A closer turn
sections.hint: Ease off before the turn. You can change steering assist in Settings.

sections.name: Over the rise
sections.hint: Let the road rise beneath you. The camera keeps a steady horizon.

sections.name: An uneven stretch
sections.hint: Small bumps ahead. Try a gentle pace.

sections.name: A quiet junction
sections.hint: Slow down and glance left and right. Continue straight.

sections.name: A place to stop
sections.hint: Brake beside the shelter. Switch off the engine when you arrive.
